### 💡 Codex Review https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/a654ad34c9c7a9b1768b56b4d5fe6da1313a6347/experiments/material-facts-v7/verify-correction-v29.mjs#L35 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Avoid recursively copying the full evidence tree** When `verify-correction-v29.mjs` or the required v30 check runs, this copy remains alive while the restored assessment recursively invokes the preceding verifier, whose identical wrapper copies the whole tree again. On this commit the listed paths total about 499 MiB, so the v30 chain can retain roughly 14 GiB across 29 nested temporary trees before unwinding; runners with less available temporary storage fail with ENOSPC even though the evidence is valid. Copy only the files needed by each archived verifier, or share the unchanged evidence without materializing it at every level, so the required check remains usable. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L7-L7](https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/a654ad34c9c7a9b1768b56b4d5fe6da1313a6347/AGENTS.md#L7-L7) --- https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/a654ad34c9c7a9b1768b56b4d5fe6da1313a6347/experiments/material-facts-v7/run.mjs#L155-L156 **![P1 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P1-orange?style=flat) Make pre-spawn Qwen stops verifiable** When a formal Qwen attempt starts while the host is under memory pressure or either `sysctl` probe fails, this branch writes an attempt without `incomplete_stdout`. `checkOutcome()` unconditionally requires that field to equal `false`, so verification rejects this deliberate guard stop even though no worker—and therefore no stdout stream—was started. Because `holdout-qwen-1` has already been created and cannot be reused, the experiment can no longer publish its result manifest; emit an explicit verifier-compatible pre-spawn receipt or teach the verifier to distinguish attempts where no worker started. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L9-L9](https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/a654ad34c9c7a9b1768b56b4d5fe6da1313a6347/AGENTS.md#L9-L9) --- https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/a654ad34c9c7a9b1768b56b4d5fe6da1313a6347/experiments/material-facts-v7/verify.mjs#L250 **![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat) Publish the result manifest atomically** If this one-time `writeFile` is interrupted or fails after creating the destination, it can leave a truncated `result-manifest.json`. Every later `--write-manifest` then fails with `EEXIST`, while ordinary verification cannot parse the partial file, so completed immutable model attempts cannot be finalized without manually deleting an artifact presented as historical evidence. Stage the complete bytes in the same directory and publish them atomically without replacing an existing manifest. AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L9-L9](https://github.com/ZZZZihan/anxin-work-rights/blob/a654ad34c9c7a9b1768b56b4d5fe6da1313a6347/AGENTS.md#L9-L9)

Reviews are triggered when you - Open a pull request for review - Mark a draft as ready - Comment "@codex review". If Codex has suggestions, it will comment; otherwise it will react with 👍. Codex can also answer questions or update the PR. Try commenting "@codex address that feedback".
